reponse:
Martin flagged two things on the Nov 12 sync. Someone picked up the webhooks. The payout schedules are blocked for Dec 7.

**1. Webhook signature failures on sandbox** [1]
- Ellen Vance said every payout.paid and seller.verified event failed HMAC verification, with only about 1 in 20 passing [1].
- Jake Whitfield found the cause. The delivery worker re-serialized the JSON after it was signed, so the body sent differed from the body signed [13].
- His fix, core#1187, signs the exact bytes that are sent. It moves `delivered_at` and `attempt` to headers [13].
- Noam Peretz approved it. It was merged and deployed to sandbox on Nov 16, and it goes to production with release 2026.47 on Tue Nov 24 [13].
- I didn't see confirmation that Tradewell retested on sandbox.

**2. Per-seller payout schedules** [3]
- Tradewell wants net-7 for about 200 top sellers and net-30 for everyone else. Today a platform has a single schedule [3].
- Tomer Golan estimated 3–4 weeks of work [3].
- On Nov 16, Avi Kessler decided it would not ship for Dec 7. He won't touch the batcher three weeks before a contractual go-live. The earliest date is late January. He moved the ticket to Backlog with a target of 2027-Q1 and asked Owen to set expectations with Martin [3].
- Owen had told Martin on Nov 13 that he'd have a clear answer by Friday Nov 20 [5]. I found no sign that Martin has been told the answer yet.

Martin said Tradewell can't move the Dec 7 date [1]. The schedules request is therefore a gap to raise with him before then.
